name: Lucky Orange
tagline: A consolation build is possible, but the paid product's decisive value sits outside a solo rebuild. For Lucky Orange, collect limited consented interaction events and build basic heatmaps for an owned site. The hard boundary is session replay, chat, surveys, funnels, privacy tooling, and always-on ingestion, plus data pipeline reliability and analytical depth.
